title: Cohort-based Drift Score + Impact Matrix for Embedding + Reranker Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement a cohort-aware evaluation and alerting flow that quantifies configuration and model variant impact on embedding + reranker offline quality (recall/precision) and runtime drift. Deliverables: 1) cohort drift score (0-1) computed from distributional and retrieval-metric signals, 2) an impact matrix mapping config/model change -> cohorts with expected delta + CI, 3) automated sample selection for manual review and shadow evals, 4) integration with rollout policies (block/canary/auto-rollback). Motivation: current global signal masks localized regressions — small but high-value cohorts (e.g., legal docs, multi-paragraph queries) have suffered regressions undetected until customer complaints. This ticket scopes instrumentation, algorithms, and console surfaces for the new signal.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff + hypothesis doc created. Linked design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVALS/Cohort+Impact+Matrix. Asking product for top 5 high-value cohorts and acceptance criteria.

2026-02-25 - Marcus Liu: Implemented initial cohort selection job (weekly sampling) and basic metadata tagging pipeline. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/483. Unit tests added for cohort assignment edge cases.

2026-03-01 - Data Science (review): Decided on hybrid drift score: weighted sum of KS-statistic on embedding cosine distribution, recall-delta on offline gold set, and change in top-k overlap. Weighting defaults: 0.4/0.4/0.2. Requested 95% bootstrap CI for recall delta.

2026-03-03 - Marcus Liu: Added bootstrap CI pipeline and synthetic-probe harness. Probe harness uses 1k synthetic queries per cohort with seeded noise. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/emb-drift/cohort-impact (team-only).

2026-03-05 - PM review (Evelyn Torres): Aligning thresholds with rollout policy: drift_score > 0.6 AND recall_delta <-0.02 -> hold canary; drift_score between 0.4-0.6 -> slow canary (1% -> 5%); drift_score < 0.4 -> proceed. PM requested escalation path for customer-facing regressions.

2026-03-07 - Design feedback (Liam O'Connor): Console surface mockups posted (Confluence). Request: add per-cohort example queries and top-n failing cases to aid triage. Design suggests inline link to replay requests for manual inspection.

2026-03-09 - Marcus Liu: Integration test failing for long-tail cohort where sample size < 30. Decision: use Bayesian shrinkage prior to stabilize recall estimates and mark cohort as 'insufficient-data' in matrix. Updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/501.

2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria: 1) Weekly cohort scores produced and stored in evals-store, 2) Impact matrix generated for each candidate model/config change within 24h of promotion to shadow, 3) Alerting rules created in PagerDuty for high-impact regressions, 4) Console shows per-cohort delta + sample examples. Next: wire alerts into rollout controller and add e2e for shadow -> canary gating.
